title: Protocol for high-throughput screening of SARS-CoV-2 main protease inhibitors using a robust fluorescence polarization assay
protocol: Prepare 10 mL FP assay buffer containing 1 mM DTT.
Pre-warm the FP assay buffer for 30 min at room temperature.
Add 10.6 μL of active Mpro (1.6 mg/mL) sample into 2 mL FP assay buffer to achieve a final concentration of 8.48 μg/mL (0.25 μM).
Gently mix the solution by pipetting.
Divide the mixed solution into 50 μL aliquots.
Add 50 μL aliquots into a black 96-well microplate.
Dilute FRET substrate solution to generate concentrations of 0, 2.5, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, or 35 μM in separate tubes.
Gently mix each diluted sample by pipetting to ensure homogeneity.
Protect all solutions from light during preparation and use.
Measure the RFU value immediately.
Place the microplate containing analyte in a microplate reader.
Set the gain value of 58.
Measure the RFU value from the top with an excitation wavelength of 320 nm and emission wavelength of 405 nm every second for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Export the obtained data as RFU values versus time (seconds).
Plot RFU values versus time using a scatter plot.
Select at least 30 continuous points covering the first 30 seconds in an initial reaction curve.
Infer a curve equation and R-squared value on the chart.
Record a slope value as an initial velocity (V=ΔRFU/s) at indicated FRET substrate concentrations.
Plot the initial velocity against the FRET substrate concentration to generate a Michaelis–Menten equation using GraphPad Prism 8.0.
Export the Km value from the analysis.
Prepare 4 mL solution containing 0.4 μM Mpro as working buffer using an aliquot of the FP assay buffer.
Dilute 34 μL aliquot of Mpro solution in 4 mL FP assay buffer to generate a final concentration of 0.4 μM.
Pre-warm the fresh FP assay buffer for 30 min at RT before use.
Gently mix by pipetting.
Dispense 29 μL aliquots into a black 96-well microplate using a multichannel pipette.
Add 1 μL sample of a natural product (1 mg/mL) to the Mpro-containing mixture using a multichannel pipette.
Designate the positive wells with GC-376 (1 μM).
Designate the negative wells with DMSO.
Designate the background wells with FITC-AVLQ peptide (20 nM).
Gently mix the microplate using a shaker.
Incubate the assay mixture for 30 min at room temperature.
Prepare 3 mL FP probe solution containing 60 nM FP probe using the remaining aliquot of the FP assay buffer.
Add 20 μL sample of 60 nM FP probe to the mixture containing natural products.
Gently mix using a shaker.
Proceed for 20 min at RT.
Protect from light.
Prepare 1.5 mL solution containing 0.3 μM avidin using the remaining aliquot of the FP assay buffer.
Add 10 μL sample of 0.3 μM avidin to the FP probe-containing mixture.
Gently mix using a shaker.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 5 min at RT.
Measure the mP value immediately.
Load the microplate onto the tray of a microplate reader and initiate the FP program by clicking "OK".
Record the mP value with excitation wavelength at 485 nm and emission wavelength at 535 nm.
Export the data for inhibition analysis of tested natural products.
Calculate the inhibitory activity of a tested compound using the provided equation.
Repeat candidate compounds showing ≥50% inhibition in triplicate to confirm inhibition against Mpro activity at the screening concentration.
Prepare all used buffers freshly before use due to instability.
Complete all steps as quickly as possible for reliable screening.
Arrange each screening microplate as shown, including positive (GC-376), negative (DMSO), and background controls.
Prepare 4 mL solution containing 0.4 μM Mpro using FP assay buffer.
Dissolve 5 mg anacardic acid in 717.3 μL DMSO to prepare a 20 mM stock solution.
Vortex the mixture to dissolve completely.
Divide the stock solution into 50 μL aliquots.
Store the aliquoted stock solution at -20°C before use.
Dilute the anacardic acid stock solution using Mpro-containing buffer to generate samples at concentrations of 100, 80, 40, 20, 10, or 5 μM.
Gently mix each diluted sample by pipetting.
Dispense 30 μL of each sample into a black 96-well microplate using a pipette.
Incubate the samples for 30 min at room temperature (RT).
Add 20 μL of 60 nM FP probe to each well containing the assay mixture using a pipette.
Gently mix the contents by shaker and protect from light.
Incubate the mixture for 20 min at RT.
Add 10 μL of 0.3 μM avidin to the previous mixture in each well using a pipette.
Gently mix the content with a shaker.
Incubate for 5 min at RT.
Place the microplate in a microplate reader and record the mP values.
Calculate the inhibition value against Mpro activity using the provided equation.
Export the inhibition values versus the indicated concentrations of the inhibitor.
Draw a dose-response curve using GraphPad Prism 8.0.
Export an IC50 value.
